updates.text: Week 13 refresh. Risers: LaNorris Sellers (70 to 24), Luke Reynolds (105 to 55), Nick Marsh (55 to 22), Darian Mensah (28 to 12) and Jadan Baugh, now RB1. Fallers: Eric Singleton Jr., Cam Coleman, Kewan Lacy (season-ending shoulder injury) and KJ Duff (ankle surgery); Arch Manning and Austin Simmons may return to school. Added Jackson Harris, Amare Thomas, Isaac Brown, Wayshawn Parker, LJ Martin, Terrance Carter Jr. and Willie Rodriguez.
Initial board: 37 prospects across QB, RB, WR and TE, with starting draft-range and production estimates.

prospects.name: Jeremiah Smith
prospects.note: 2026: 80 catches, 1,317 yards, 15 TD through 10 games. Top overall prospect on most boards.

prospects.name: Charlie Becker
prospects.note: 2026: 53 catches, 950 yards, 10 TD (17.9 per catch). Now WR2 on several boards.

prospects.name: Nick Marsh
prospects.note: Michigan State transfer who has climbed into first-round range on several boards this fall.

prospects.name: Cam Coleman
prospects.note: Quiet first year at Texas: 24 catches, 425 yards, 7 TD in nine games. Has slipped toward the late first/second round.

prospects.name: Jackson Harris
prospects.note: Started at Stanford and Hawaii before LSU; rose into first-round range this fall.

prospects.name: Reed Harris
prospects.note: Boston College transfer and a steady riser; now projected late first to second round.

prospects.name: KJ Duff
prospects.note: Out for the rest of 2026 after high ankle surgery; expected back for pre-draft work in January.

prospects.name: Wyatt Young
prospects.note: North Texas transfer (2025: 1,264 yards, 10 TD); moving up into Round 2 projections.

prospects.name: Ryan Coleman-Williams
prospects.note: Formerly Ryan Williams. Projected Day 2; staying healthy has been the question.

prospects.name: Amare Thomas
prospects.note: Projected Round 2-3.

prospects.name: Deuce Alexander
prospects.note: Big-play threat; transferred from Wake Forest.

prospects.name: Junior Sherrill
prospects.note: Projected Day 2-3; gaining traction on recent boards.

prospects.name: Mario Craver
prospects.note: Smaller, dynamic slot/vertical threat; projections have drifted to Day 2-3.

prospects.name: Ryan Wingo
prospects.note: Former five-star; ball security remains the knock and projections range from Round 2 to Day 3.

prospects.name: Eric Singleton Jr.
prospects.note: Has fallen off most early-round projections during 2026.

prospects.name: Jadan Baugh
prospects.note: 2026: 981 rushing yards, 16 TD through 11 games. Now RB1 on several boards.

prospects.name: Kewan Lacy
prospects.note: Dislocated shoulder Oct. 24 and expected to miss the rest of 2026 (388 yards, 5 TD in six games). Led FBS with 24 rushing TD in 2025.

prospects.name: Ahmad Hardy
prospects.note: Shot in the leg in May; returned Oct. 31. Ran for 1,649 yards and 16 TD in 2025. Some project a return to school.

prospects.name: Wayshawn Parker
prospects.note: Washington State transfer; 6.6 yards per carry in 2025.

prospects.name: LJ Martin
prospects.note: Big back projected Day 2-3.

prospects.name: Isaac Brown
prospects.note: Averaged 8.8 yards per carry in 2025; explosive Day 2 candidate.

prospects.name: Nate Frazier
prospects.note: Power plus open-field speed; durability is the main question. Day 2-3 projection.

prospects.name: Raleek Brown
prospects.note: Receiver-first back; 1,141 rushing yards at Arizona State in 2025.

prospects.name: Mark Fletcher Jr.
prospects.note: Big back with 26 career rushing TD; projected Day 2-3.

prospects.name: Cameron Dickey
prospects.note: Not listed on most current position boards.

prospects.name: Hollywood Smothers
prospects.note: Transferred from NC State; projected Day 3.

prospects.name: Drew Mestemaker
prospects.note: 2026: 3,533 yards, 30 TD, 11 INT through 11 games. QB1 or QB2 on most boards.

prospects.name: CJ Carr
prospects.note: 2026: 67.7%, 2,697 yards, 24 TD, 3 INT. Has pushed for QB1 in recent mocks.

prospects.name: Darian Mensah
prospects.note: 2026: 75.4%, 3,317 yards, 29 TD, 4 INT. Moved into the top-15 range on several boards.

prospects.name: Dante Moore
prospects.note: Concussion vs. USC ended his 2026 after four games; unclear whether he declares.

prospects.name: LaNorris Sellers
prospects.note: 2026: 2,187 passing yards, 17 TD, 8 INT plus 661 rushing yards and 7 TD. Big riser into Round 1.

prospects.name: Trinidad Chambliss
prospects.note: Up-and-down 2026; will turn 25 in August 2027.

prospects.name: Arch Manning
prospects.note: 2026: 2,485 yards, 21 TD, 10 INT. Stock has dipped; a return to school or transfer is possible.

prospects.name: Julian Sayin
prospects.note: Very efficient starter throwing to Jeremiah Smith.

prospects.name: Austin Simmons
prospects.note: Lefty with top-QB tools, but widely expected to return to Missouri for 2027.

prospects.name: Jayden Maiava
prospects.note: Projected Day 3 in recent mocks.

prospects.name: Trey'Dez Green
prospects.note: Big target with 12 contested catches in 2025; TE1 or TE2 on most boards.

prospects.name: Jamari Johnson
prospects.note: Most NFL-ready TE per many evaluators; tough after the catch.

prospects.name: Luke Reynolds
prospects.note: Penn State transfer and the fastest-rising TE this fall; now a Round 2 projection.

prospects.name: Terrance Carter Jr.
prospects.note: H-back transfer from Louisiana; 23 broken tackles after the catch in 2025.

prospects.name: Willie Rodriguez
prospects.note: No drops on 29 career catchable targets; Day 2-3 projection.

prospects.name: Benjamin Brahmer
prospects.note: Iowa State transfer; projected Day 3.

prospects.name: Garrett Oakley
prospects.note: Size, athleticism and blocking; projected Day 3.

prospects.name: Hayden Hansen
prospects.note: Big in-line tight end with heavy snap experience; unranked on most boards.
